description: Compare two complete OPC UA NodeSet2 XML documents when both fit in a single request. Pass old_nodeset_xml as the full baseline revision and new_nodeset_xml as the full candidate revision. The deterministic report returns result (COMPATIBLE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, BREAKING, or INSUFFICIENT_INPUT), old_node_count, new_node_count, issue_count, a summary keyed by change code, and issues containing code, severity, node_id and detail. Examples include NODE_ADDED, NODE_REMOVED, DATA_TYPE_CHANGED and reference changes. For large XML documents use begin_nodeset_upload + append_nodeset_chunk for each revision, then audit_uploaded_nodesets instead.
name: audit_nodeset_compatibility
